value: The 49th ACM SIGPLAN Symposium on Principles of Programming Languages (POPL 2022), held January 16-22, 2022, served as a premier forum for discussions on all aspects of programming languages and systems, spanning theoretical frameworks to practical applications. Adapting to the Omicron variant surge, the symposium implemented a comprehensive hybrid format, combining in-person sessions in Philadelphia with robust virtual participation via Airmeet and public YouTube livestreams, while also incorporating on-site safety measures. A separate virtual workshop on January 27-28 further extended engagement opportunities, providing networking, mentoring, and in-depth Q&A sessions designed for global accessibility and cross-timezone interaction.
